Futbol Club Andorra is a professional football club based in Andorra la Vella, Andorra, that currently competes in Segunda División of the Spanish league system. The club was founded in 1942 and currently plays its home fixtures at Estadi de la FAF in Encamp. Even though they are based in the microstate of Andorra, the club voluntarily affiliated to the Catalan Football Federation, and as a result, has been allowed to compete in the Spanish league system since 1948.
